purpose: planning only; no randomized experiment was run
design: 3 arms within each behavior segment: holdout, generic campaign, segment-tailored campaign
primary_comparison: tailored vs generic within each segment (two primary segment comparisons)
primary_outcome: any coupon redemption within 30 days of assignment

power_assumptions.method: normal approximation for two independent proportions, rounded up
power_assumptions.lifts: relative lift above historical descriptive proxy

current_data_capacity.reason: 30% MDE requires 6,152 households per arm in the lower-activity segment and 1,217 per arm in the higher-activity segment; there are 749/1,568 households total in the respective segments at this cut and historical assignment cannot be randomized retroactively.

limitations: Historical campaign response rates are nonrandomized, repeated household-campaign observations and not causal baselines.
Cutoff rates overlap; their unweighted average is a planning proxy only.
The calculation does not account for noncompliance, attrition, interference or household-level clustering beyond one-row-per-household randomization.
A genuine campaign test requires a new prospective randomized assignment; no control assignment is fabricated from Complete Journey.
